title: The Painted Cipher
author: Mirabel Okafor
blurb: Orsen Okonkwo, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
